name: redactcast
title: RedactCast
description: Reversible PII Masker: Sanitize sensitive data before sending to AI, and restore it locally.
author: Tomokisan

preferences.name: teamApiKey
preferences.title: Team API Key
preferences.description: B2B Sync Engine API Key to download custom rules.

commands.name: mask-clipboard
commands.title: Mask Clipboard
commands.description: Replaces sensitive data in the clipboard with placeholders.

commands.name: rehydrate-clipboard
commands.title: Rehydrate Clipboard
commands.description: Restores the original data back into the AI's response.

commands.name: force-sync-rules
commands.title: Force Sync Team Rules
commands.description: Downloads the latest masking rules from your organization.

commands.name: scramble-draft-text
commands.title: Scramble Draft Text
commands.subtitle: Non-Security Draft Copy
commands.description: Create non-reversible, layout-matched draft copy; not security redaction

preferences.name: source
preferences.title: Preferred Source
preferences.description: Read the preferred source first. The other source is used only when the preferred source is empty.

preferences.name: action
preferences.title: Output Action
preferences.description: Replace the current selection or copy the scrambled text as plain text.

preferences.name: scrambleNumbers
preferences.title: Draft Copy
preferences.description: Replace every decimal digit while preserving its writing system, position, and count.
preferences.label: Scramble Numbers
